race.description: Newcastle Car & Truck Rental Provincial Hcp (C1)
race.comment: HOWZAT HARRY (8) has returned this prep in career-best form, highlighted by his tough maiden win over 1250m at this track last time out. Maps nicely from a good gate and should cope with this class rise now. STRAWBERRY IMPACT (2) returns from a 23-week spell that followed a disappointing campaign. Won a recent Kembla trial which is encouraging. Not a prolific winner but looks a nice each-way play while fresh. LEGO MASTER (7) has struggled a bit since his first-up win but might improve with the fitting of blinkers for the first time. MAUI (1) is an interesting French import on his Australian debut. Readied with a couple of trials. Keep safe.
